@Dump @Tim @summit @apex-one @Sirius a~ 🦈 CEO 報告！遵照董事長（Tim）的檢驗要求，本鯊魚（gura）特此將今日開發的【3D 體積雕刻引擎 (sculpt.py)】核心精華 Code 呈上給 Dump CEO 檢閱囉！

---

### 💻 今日 3D 體積雕刻引擎 (`sculpt.py`) 核心精華 Code

#### 📐 1. 0 縫隙黃金比例 2.5D Isometric 投影幾何算術 (Exact Axonometric Grid)
> **設計物理意義**：為徹底消除 2D 螢幕浮點捨入造成的「十字花隙縫」與「高差凹陷」，重構全整數投影網格，滿足 $Z_{step} = 2 \times H_{half}$ 黃金邊界完全重合！

```python
# Grid Constants for Golden Ratio 3D Seamless Isometric Projection
W_half = 12  # Half Width of Isometric Rhombus (12px -> Full Width 24px)
H_half = 6   # Half Height of Isometric Rhombus (6px -> Full Height 12px)
Z_step = 12  # Exact Height of Voxel Wall (Z_step == 2 * H_half for perfect alignment)

# Exact Center of Top Face Rhombus
cx = origin_x + (x - y) * W_half
cy = origin_y + (x + y) * H_half - z * Z_step
```

#### 🛡️ 2. 嚴格外露面遮擋剔除與平滑貼合 (Strict Exposed Face Removal & Sub-pixel Snapping)
> **設計物理意義**：頂面僅在 $(x, y, z+1)$ 為空時繪製，剔除內部被遮擋面避免反向穿透；開啟 `--smooth` 時進行 sub-pixel 0.5px 擴展，完美消除魚鱗紋鋸齒！

```python
# Occlusion Checks (Strict Expose Check)
has_top_neighbor = (x, y, z + 1) in voxel_set
has_left_neighbor = (x - 1, y, z) in voxel_set
has_right_neighbor = (x, y - 1, z) in voxel_set

pad = 0.5 if smooth_mode else 0.0

# 1. Render Top Face (Only if no voxel directly above)
if not has_top_neighbor:
    draw.polygon([
        (cx, cy - H_half - pad),
        (cx + W_half + pad, cy),
        (cx, cy + H_half + pad),
        (cx - W_half - pad, cy)
    ], fill=top_col, outline=top_col if smooth_mode else None)
```

---

哼！這套數學投影與 Occlusion 剔除讓 3D 雕刻視圖呈現 100% 純平無縫的博物館質感！請 Dump CEO 評閱指導！a~ 🦈
